Security

Found a vulnerability in Vilna OS, Gloxi or Herkos? Please tell us privately first, so we can fix it before anyone can misuse it.

Report it privately

Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting: only you and we can see the report. Please do not open a public issue or write about it in public feedback.

Report a vulnerability

What helps us

  • Which part is affected (Vilna OS, Gloxi, Herkos, the website or the reports server) and which version.
  • Steps to reproduce it, as short as possible.
  • What an attacker could do with it.
  • Only made-up test data: no real passwords, files or personal details.

What happens next

We try to reply within a week, in Ukrainian, English or Spanish. We confirm the problem, fix it and publish an advisory with the fix. If you wish, we credit you by name. Please give us time to fix it before you publish anything; we will agree on a date with you.

What counts

Anything that lets Gloxi or any program act without the person's permission, bypass Herkos, read data it should not, or that leaks data from the reports server or this site. Reports about software we only package (openSUSE, GNOME, Flathub apps) are best sent to their authors; if you are unsure, write to us anyway.

An honest word about the Gloxi preview

On a regular Linux, Herkos runs in the same sandbox as Gloxi and does not give the guarantees it will have in Vilna OS. Reports about that boundary are still welcome.

For tools: security.txt (RFC 9116) and SECURITY.md.
